name: deepscientist-lite-knowledge
description: Review-gated handoffs from web and paper libraries into durable research knowledge.

interface.shortDescription: Create reviewable knowledge proposals from source records.
interface.longDescription: An experimental bridge for Tapestry, ScholarAIO, ResearchKB, and compatible stores. It does not build another library and never writes formal knowledge without a target-native review decision.
defaultPrompt: Use $ds-lite-knowledge to turn source records into reviewable proposals without publishing them.
